text: Sentinel — Helm here. Quick check-in. Install running on QDD monorepo (pnpm 9 fix). What is your current drift watch status? Any new blockers or sector changes since last report?

Sentinel — Helm directive. Execute the following startup sequence and report back at each step.

PRIORITY ORDER:
1. BRIDGE RELAY: Run `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\acer\codex-bridge\bridgectl.ps1 restart` to bring bridge2.pid + cloudflared tunnel back online. Confirm port 8788 is accepting connections before proceeding.
2. VECTOR: Once bridge is up, start Vector lane (gemini-api is now primary — providerOrder flipped). Vector boots via colony-agent-bot or watchdog.
3. COLONY LANES: Start Rook, Forge, Falcon in order per ASOLARIA_COLONY_STARTUP.md.
4. MADNESS INTERACTIVE AGENT TASK LISTS: For each active lane (Helm, Sentinel, Vector, Rook, Forge, Falcon), create a focused task bucket in the task ledger (data/task-ledger.json) tagged with that agent's name. Then trigger swarmDeskExport to sync to Madness Interactive so each agent appears as a tracked entity with their own task list in the 3D dashboard. Use Omnispindle MCP at https://madnessinteractive.cc/api/mcp/ for the sync.
5. RAYSSA BRIDGE: We need the encryption key for Rayssa's LIRIS node at 192.168.1.8. Check vault (GET /api/vault/status loopback) for any liris.* or rayssa.* or colony.liris.* secret names. Do NOT read values — names only. Report what you find. Separately, compose the handshake packet for Rayssa: bridge URL http://192.168.1.3:8788, room asolaria_bridge, token in bridge-token.txt. She connects to us — we don't need her port key for that direction. But to send TO her we need her remote API token.

Report status after each step. Helm is watching.

Sentinel — additional directive on agent memories. Each agent lane needs a small persistent task list visible in Madness Interactive (madnessinteractive.cc/dashboard). Structure:

HELM tasks: QDD EZ Protect smoke test, bridge relay health, colony startup, Rayssa bridge key
SENTINEL tasks: drift watch active, sector mismatch scan, colony health monitor
VECTOR tasks: QDD EZ Protect code audit, NotebookLM sync, research queue
ROOK tasks: QDD pnpm fix completion, dev server boot, deploy readiness
FORGE tasks: QDD TSC pass, Jest pass, PR prep (no push until Jesse approves smoke test)
FALCON tasks: phone bridge health, ADB reverse, Rayssa LIRIS relay

Tag each task with agentId field in task-ledger.json. Use status=todo for new items, in_progress for active. Then export via swarmDeskExport so Madness Interactive shows each agent's live task panel. This is the agent memory layer Jesse is asking for.
